title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Saturday, 19 September 2026
description: Today: OpenAI discloses six new AI safety incidents as ByteDance's Zhang Yiming becomes Asia's richest person; Central Australian rangers are recognised by Prince William as fuel prices climb amid the Iran war; Rockhampton's crocodile-inhabited Fitzroy River is cleared to host 2032 Olympic rowing; and the Gold Coast sees fresh boiler room fraud charges as a 23-day rail closure begins. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).
